query:
SELECT weekNumber, weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount, source, createdAt, updatedAt
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber = 19 AND campus = 'Canton'
  AND subgroup IN ('Revolution Canton Check-In', 'Kids', 'Online', 'RevStudents HS', 'RevStudents MS')
ORDER BY subgroup;
